# CC0 run fixtures

Three complete run groups extracted from the previously saved Infrabel monthly
raw-punctuality files. Rows are copied without changing cell values; only the
standard CSV writer formatting is normalised. These are observations, not an
accepted path, a real change pair, or evidence of works effects.

The manifest records source URLs, raw selection keys, row counts and hashes.
CC0 evidence: archived handoff sources row dated 2026-11-14 records the Infrabel
catalogue metadata as “Open licentie CC0 - Universeel” for the monthly raw data.
Public catalogue: https://opendata.infrabel.be/explore/dataset/stiptheid-gegevens-maandelijksebestanden/

Timezone is assumed Europe/Brussels and remains labelled as unverified on
clock-change nights. The overnight fixture spans 26/27 March 2026. Header order
differs between the 2023 and 2026 files; parsing must use header names.
